dedupe_keys.name: simplywood a set of tools supporting the numerical simulation of the in plane seismic response of timber diaphragms retrofitted with plywood panels

description: TU Delft researchers publish SimPlyWood for numerical simulation of timber diaphragms strengthened with plywood panels. The package implements a macro-element representation of their in-plane seismic response. An Excel worksheet determines model inputs, and a user-supplied subroutine connects the representation to DIANA FEA. The provider lists a compiled DLL and original FORTRAN source alongside documentation. These components form one published model resource. Coverage: The method is not tied to a named geographic test site in the reviewed description. Software version compatibility and evaluation dates are not established. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: GPL-3.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: The archive was not obtained, the subroutine was not executed, and claimed behaviour was not reproduced. DIANA FEA is a required external dependency. Simulation uses include building seismic-response modelling for retrofit design. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
